articleTitle: Why Work-Life Balance Advice Ignores the Mental Load
imageHeadline: Work-Life Balance Advice Misses the Mental Load
imageSubtext: Why time management tips don't address who's planning everything
pinTitle: Why Work-Life Balance Advice Ignores the Mental Load | Evidence-Based Wellness
pinDescription: Most work-life balance strategies assume household tasks are split evenly—but they rarely account for the invisible planning, organizing, and decision-making that falls disproportionately on women. Explore what the research shows about mental load and what actually helps.
